concerns.text: FR-005 (DE analysis), FR-006 (meta-analysis/fallback), and SC-002 (statistical significance) lack implementation tasks. T023a, T023b, T024a, T024b, and T024c are marked unimplemented (`- [ ]`), leaving the core cross-cancer biomarker identification logic without a defined execution path.

FR-008 (LOO validation) and SC-003 (generalizability) are not covered by implementation tasks. T035 (LOO Re-training) and T036 (LOO Evaluation) are unimplemented (`- [ ]`), preventing the system from performing the mandatory leave-one-cancer-type-out validation.

FR-009 (calibration/PR curves), FR-011 (DeLong's test), and SC-001 (AUC target) lack full implementation coverage. T037 (External GEO Validation), T039 (DeLong's Test), and T038 (Calibration Curves) are unimplemented (`- [ ]`), creating a gap between success criteria and actionable tasks.

Task T005 references Docker image tag `biocontainers/deseq2:.0`. The tag `:.0` is syntactically invalid and not a valid semantic version, contradicting Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which requires pinned, valid versions. This is a stale/incorrect tag from an older draft.
